contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #196: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture.
Exact finite signed occurrence-to-stage counting for the staged September 23 2026 manuscript; the full group-algebra theorem is not asserted.

definitions.block: finite ordered set of underlying edge positions
definitions.occurrence: one traversal of a block, distinct even on repeated uses
definitions.link: partial translation equality or reflection inverse equality from an occurrence matching

contexts.statement: Deterministic topology of a finite graph immersion j:Gamma->F into a finite rose, with a prescribed vertex set R and cone complex X=F union_j disjoint-union K_Lambda; arrangement exclusion is a hypothesis, not a random-graph conclusion.

definitions.arrangement: Definition def:arrangement in staged planar.tex, with roots in R, actual graph lifts, inverse-letter planar pairing, distinct underlying unoriented graph edges, and at least one ordinary cyclic boundary
definitions.failure: nonzero spherical homotopy class, or a trivial-labelled graph path from a fixed r in R to a fixed distinct y
definitions.cone: abstract contractible cone, not assumed embedded in X

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 196 (A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture.; papers: A Torsion-Free Group Algebra with Zero Divisors; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/196.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Exact finite verification of the signed occurrence-to-stage counting mechanism, deriving word counts from comparisons and multiplicity balance from a partial matching.
Root words and unconstrained target letters injectively encode assignments along an ordered spanning tree; any stage projection has no larger cardinality.
A nonzero translation self-link with k comparisons on h positions allows at most |T|^(h-k) root words; a reflection self-link comparing more than h/2 positions allows no reduced word.
For a finite partial matching of occurrences with no pair inside a block, 2 times any block multiplicity is at most total multiplicity plus the number of unmatched occurrences.
A finite squared-word moment bound bounds the cardinality of each positive-weight bin.
The finite stage-product exponent is at most -delta*s*S/2 + a0*s*b, with explicit propagation errors added separately.
With the manuscript's bounded-chain, alignment, squared-word and prescription inputs, the finite bound gives one epsilon depending only on the types for every fixed K,C,I.
Boundedly many chain comparisons admit the common nearly aligned subdivision and the stated o(L) uncovered-mass errors.
Immersed paths with at most one interval path have sum_j(V_j-E_j-k_j) <= 0.
For the prescribed turn weights, sum_W P(W)^2 <= exp(-2*delta*h) for all sufficiently large h.
The conditioned matching model satisfies the uniform few-edge prescription estimate.
Bounded-pattern exclusion and diameter control exclude every reduced planar arrangement.
Arrangement exclusion implies asphericity and separation of the prescribed roots.
A finitely presented torsion-free group with a finite two-dimensional classifying space has two nonzero factors over F_2 whose product is zero.

For every finite ranked coordinate comparison system, root dictionaries and squared root-word mass bound arbitrary feasible-word projections; nonzero translation self-links have at most |T|^(h-k) root words and inverse-reflection self-links of length greater than h/2 admit no reduced word; an actual partial occurrence partner involution yields the multiplicity balance and matched-component entropy exponent. The uniform epsilon arithmetic and log(129)<5 also hold. Precisely the declarations in Main.lean, interpreted by research/statement_fidelity.md; no random-graph or topological theorem is included.

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace OccurrenceEntropy

theorem root_code_bound
    {V A : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed root : Finset V)
    (D : Finset ({v : V // v ∈ root} → A))
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (_hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D) :
    F.card ≤ D.card * Fintype.card A ^ (seed \ root).card := by
  classical
  let code : {w // w ∈ F} →
      {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) :=
    fun w => (⟨fun v => w.val v.val, hdict w.val w.property⟩,
      fun v => w.val v.val)
  have hinj : Function.Injective code := by
    intro w w' heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    have same : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ v : V, rank v = n → w.val v = w'.val v := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro v hv
        by_cases hs : v ∈ seed
        · by_cases hr : v ∈ root
          · exact congrArg
              (fun c : {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) =>
                c.1.val ⟨v, hr⟩) heq
          · exact congrArg
              (fun c : {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) =>
                c.2 ⟨v, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hs, hr⟩⟩) heq
        · rw [hdep w.val w.property v hs, hdep w'.val w'.property v hs]
          exact congrArg (turn v)
            (ih (rank (parent v)) (by simpa [hv] using hlower v hs)
              (parent v) rfl)
    exact funext fun v => same (rank v) v rfl
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective code hinj
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fun] using hc

theorem projection_code_bound
    {V A B : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq B]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed root : Finset V)
    (D : Finset ({v : V // v ∈ root} → A))
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D)
    (project : (V → A) → B) :
    (F.image project).card ≤ D.card * Fintype.card A ^ (seed \ root).card :=
  (Finset.card_image_le).trans
    (root_code_bound F seed root D rank parent turn hroot hlower hdep hdict)

theorem acyclic_code_bound
    {V A : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed : Finset V)
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v))) :
    F.card ≤ Fintype.card A ^ seed.card := by
  classical
  have h := root_code_bound F seed ∅ Finset.univ rank parent turn
    (by simp) hlower hdep (by intro w _; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
  simpa using h

theorem translation_self_bound
    {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (h t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (target : Finset (Fin h)) (F : Finset (Fin h → A))
    (hshift : ∀ v ∈ target, t ≤ v.val)
    (hword : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v ∈ target,
      w v = w ⟨v.val - t, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) v.isLt⟩) :
    F.card ≤ Fintype.card A ^ (h - target.card) := by
  classical
  let parent : Fin h → Fin h :=
    fun v => ⟨v.val - t, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) v.isLt⟩
  have h := acyclic_code_bound F targetᶜ Fin.val parent (fun _ x => x)
    (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' : v ∈ target := by simpa using hv
      have := hshift v hv'
      simp only [parent]
      omega)
    (by
      intro w hw v hv
      exact hword w hw v (by simpa using hv))
  simpa [Finset.card_compl] using h

theorem nearly_full_reflection_impossible
    {A : Type*} (inv : A → A)
    (hfixed : ∀ a, inv a ≠ a)
    (w : ℕ → A) (h l k a : ℕ)
    (hfull : h < 2 * k)
    (hdom : l + k ≤ h)
    (himage_left : l + k - 1 ≤ a)
    (himage_right : a - l < h)
    (hreduced : ∀ i, i + 1 < h → w (i + 1) ≠ inv (w i))
    (hcompare : ∀ i, l ≤ i → i < l + k → w i = inv (w (a - i))) :
    False := by
  have hcenter_lo : l ≤ a / 2 := by omega
  have hcenter_hi : a / 2 < l + k := by omega
  by_cases heven : a % 2 = 0
  · have hmirror : a - a / 2 = a / 2 := by omega
    have hc := hcompare (a / 2) hcenter_lo hcenter_hi
    rw [hmirror] at hc
    exact hfixed (w (a / 2)) hc.symm
  · have hodd : a % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have hu : a / 2 + 1 < l + k := by omega
    have hmirror : a - (a / 2 + 1) = a / 2 := by omega
    have hc := hcompare (a / 2 + 1) (by omega) hu
    rw [hmirror] at hc
    exact hreduced (a / 2) (by omega) hc

theorem occurrence_balance
    {O B : Type*} [Fintype O] [DecidableEq O] [DecidableEq B]
    (owner : O → B) (matched : Finset O) (pair : O → O)
    (_hclosed : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair o ∈ matched)
    (hinvol : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair (pair o) = o)
    (hdifferent : ∀ o ∈ matched, owner (pair o) ≠ owner o)
    (r : B) :
    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = r)).card ≤
      Fintype.card O + matchedᶜ.card := by
  classical
  let R := Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = r)
  have hmap : Set.MapsTo pair ((R ∩ matched : Finset O) : Set O)
      ((Rᶜ : Finset O) : Set O) := by
    intro o ho
    have hoR : owner o = r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).1).2
    have hd := hdifferent o (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).2
    simpa [R, hoR] using hd
  have hinj : Set.InjOn pair ((R ∩ matched : Finset O) : Set O) := by
    intro o ho o' ho' heq
    have := congrArg pair heq
    simpa [hinvol o (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).2,
      hinvol o' (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho').2] using this
  have hmatched := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn pair hmap hinj
  have hfree : (R \ matched).card ≤ matchedᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro o ho
    simpa using (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ho).2
  have hpartition := Finset.card_inter_add_card_sdiff R matched
  have htotal := Finset.card_add_card_compl R
  change 2 * R.card ≤ Fintype.card O + matchedᶜ.card
  omega

theorem squared_mass_bin_bound
    {W : Type*} [Fintype W] (p : W → ℝ)
    (D : Finset W) (c Q : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : ∀ w, 0 ≤ p w)
    (hbin : ∀ w ∈ D, c ≤ p w)
    (hmass : ∑ w, (p w) ^ 2 ≤ Q) :
    (D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤ Q := by
  classical
  calc
    (D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 = ∑ _w ∈ D, c ^ 2 := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ w ∈ D, (p w) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro w hw
      have := hbin w hw
      have := hp w
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ ∑ w, (p w) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ D)
      intro w _ _
      positivity
    _ ≤ Q := hmass

theorem projected_moment_bound
    {V A B : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq B]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed root : Finset V)
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (p : ({v : V // v ∈ root} → A) → ℝ) (c Q : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : ∀ r, 0 ≤ p r)
    (hmass : ∑ r, (p r) ^ 2 ≤ Q)
    (hbin : ∀ w ∈ F, c ≤ p (fun v => w v.val))
    (project : (V → A) → B) :
    ((F.image project).card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤
      Q * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by
  classical
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun r => c ≤ p r)
  have hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D := by
    intro w hw
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hbin w hw⟩
  have hn := projection_code_bound F seed root D rank parent turn
    hroot hlower hdep hdict project
  have hnreal :
      ((F.image project).card : ℝ) ≤
        (D.card : ℝ) * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hm := squared_mass_bin_bound p D c Q hc hp
    (fun r hr => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2) hmass
  calc
    ((F.image project).card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤
        ((D.card : ℝ) * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card) * c ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnreal (sq_nonneg c)
    _ = ((D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2) *
        (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by ring
    _ ≤ Q * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (by positivity)

theorem component_exponent
    {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m d : B → ℝ)
    (r : B) (z b delta upper : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i)
    (hupp : ∀ i, d i ≤ upper)
    (hmin : ∀ i, d r ≤ d i)
    (hbalance : 2 * z ≤ (∑ i, m i) + b) :
    -(∑ i, m i * d i) + 2 * z * d r - delta * z ≤
      -(delta / 2) * (∑ i, m i) + upper * b := by
  have hcost : (∑ i, m i) * d r ≤ ∑ i, m i * d i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmin i) (hm i)
  have hrnon : 0 ≤ d r := by have := hlow r; linarith
  have hu : 0 ≤ upper := hrnon.trans (hupp r)
  by_cases hz : 2 * z ≤ ∑ i, m i
  · have hgap := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hz)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlow r))
    have hfree := mul_nonneg hu hb
    nlinarith
  · have hz' : 0 ≤ 2 * z - ∑ i, m i := by linarith
    have hgap := mul_nonneg hz' (sub_nonneg.mpr (hupp r))
    have hfree := mul_nonneg hu (show 0 ≤ b - (2 * z - ∑ i, m i) by linarith)
    have hdecay := mul_nonneg hdelta
      (show 0 ≤ z - (∑ i, m i) / 2 by linarith)
    nlinarith

theorem self_component_exponent
    {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m d : B → ℝ) (delta : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i) (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i) :
    -(∑ i, m i * d i) ≤ -(delta / 2) * (∑ i, m i) := by
  have hcost : (∑ i, m i) * (delta / 2) ≤ ∑ i, m i * d i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlow i) (hm i)
  nlinarith

theorem matched_component_exponent
    {O B : Type*} [Fintype O] [DecidableEq O] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (owner : O → B) (matched : Finset O) (pair : O → O)
    (hclosed : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair o ∈ matched)
    (hinvol : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair (pair o) = o)
    (hdifferent : ∀ o ∈ matched, owner (pair o) ≠ owner o)
    (d : B → ℝ) (r rmax : B) (delta upper : ℝ)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i)
    (hupp : ∀ i, d i ≤ upper)
    (hmin : ∀ i, d r ≤ d i) :
    -(∑ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ) * d i) +
        2 * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) * d r -
        delta * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) ≤
      -(delta / 2) * (Fintype.card O : ℝ) + upper * (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) := by
  have hsum : (∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card) =
      Fintype.card O := by
    simpa using
      (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
        (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.univ)
        (f := owner) (by intro o _; exact Finset.mem_univ _)).symm
  have hsreal :
      (∑ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ)) =
        (Fintype.card O : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hbal := occurrence_balance owner matched pair hclosed hinvol hdifferent rmax
  have hbalreal :
      2 * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (Fintype.card O : ℝ) + (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbal
  have hx := component_exponent
    (fun i => ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ))
    d r ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ)
    (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) delta upper
    (by intro i; positivity) hdelta (by positivity)
    hlow hupp hmin (by simpa [hsreal] using hbalreal)
  simpa [hsreal] using hx

theorem uniform_epsilon_budget
    (delta a H b error epsilon : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < delta) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (he : epsilon ≤ delta / (16 * (1 + a)))
    (hb : b ≤ epsilon * H)
    (herr : error ≤ delta * H / 8) :
    -(delta / 2) * H + a * b + error ≤ -(delta / 4) * H := by
  have hden : 0 < 16 * (1 + a) := by positivity
  have he' : epsilon * (16 * (1 + a)) ≤ delta :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp he
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he' hH
  have hab := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb ha
  have hsmall : a * (epsilon * H) ≤ delta * H / 16 := by
    by_cases hn : 0 ≤ epsilon
    · have hnon := mul_nonneg hn hH
      nlinarith

theorem log129_lt_five : Real.log 129 < 5 := by
      have he : (21 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 20) := by
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 / 20 : ℝ)]
      have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 21 / 20) he 100
      have heq : Real.exp (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 100 = Real.exp 5 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        norm_num
      rw [heq] at hp
      apply (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 129)).mpr
      have hr : (129 : ℝ) < (21 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 100 := by norm_num
      exact hr.trans_le hp

theorem manuscript_epsilon_budget
        (H b error : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
        (hb : b ≤ H / 57600) (he : error ≤ H / 4800) :
        -(1 / 1200 : ℝ) * H + 5 * b + error ≤ -(1 / 2400 : ℝ) * H := by
      nlinarith
    · have hn' : epsilon * H ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_ge hn) hH
      have ha' := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha hn'
      have hpos := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hd) hH
      nlinarith
  nlinarith

end OccurrenceEntropy

    (_hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D) :
    F.card ≤ D.card * Fintype.card A ^ (seed \ root).card := by
  classical
  let code : {w // w ∈ F} →
      {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) :=
    fun w => (⟨fun v => w.val v.val, hdict w.val w.property⟩,
      fun v => w.val v.val)
  have hinj : Function.Injective code := by
    intro w w' heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    have same : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ v : V, rank v = n → w.val v = w'.val v := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro v hv
        by_cases hs : v ∈ seed
        · by_cases hr : v ∈ root
          · exact congrArg
              (fun c : {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) =>
                c.1.val ⟨v, hr⟩) heq
          · exact congrArg
              (fun c : {r // r ∈ D} × ({v : V // v ∈ seed \ root} → A) =>
                c.2 ⟨v, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hs, hr⟩⟩) heq
        · rw [hdep w.val w.property v hs, hdep w'.val w'.property v hs]
          exact congrArg (turn v)
            (ih (rank (parent v)) (by simpa [hv] using hlower v hs)
              (parent v) rfl)
    exact funext fun v => same (rank v) v rfl
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective code hinj
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_fun] using hc

theorem projection_code_bound
    {V A B : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq B]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed root : Finset V)
    (D : Finset ({v : V // v ∈ root} → A))
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D)
    (project : (V → A) → B) :
    (F.image project).card ≤ D.card * Fintype.card A ^ (seed \ root).card :=
  (Finset.card_image_le).trans
    (root_code_bound F seed root D rank parent turn hroot hlower hdep hdict)

theorem acyclic_code_bound
    {V A : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed : Finset V)
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v))) :
    F.card ≤ Fintype.card A ^ seed.card := by
  classical
  have h := root_code_bound F seed ∅ Finset.univ rank parent turn
    (by simp) hlower hdep (by intro w _; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
  simpa using h

theorem translation_self_bound
    {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (h t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (target : Finset (Fin h)) (F : Finset (Fin h → A))
    (hshift : ∀ v ∈ target, t ≤ v.val)
    (hword : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v ∈ target,
      w v = w ⟨v.val - t, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) v.isLt⟩) :
    F.card ≤ Fintype.card A ^ (h - target.card) := by
  classical
  let parent : Fin h → Fin h :=
    fun v => ⟨v.val - t, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) v.isLt⟩
  have h := acyclic_code_bound F targetᶜ Fin.val parent (fun _ x => x)
    (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' : v ∈ target := by simpa using hv
      have := hshift v hv'
      simp only [parent]
      omega)
    (by
      intro w hw v hv
      exact hword w hw v (by simpa using hv))
  simpa [Finset.card_compl] using h

theorem nearly_full_reflection_impossible
    {A : Type*} (inv : A → A)
    (hfixed : ∀ a, inv a ≠ a)
    (w : ℕ → A) (h l k a : ℕ)
    (hfull : h < 2 * k)
    (hdom : l + k ≤ h)
    (himage_left : l + k - 1 ≤ a)
    (himage_right : a - l < h)
    (hreduced : ∀ i, i + 1 < h → w (i + 1) ≠ inv (w i))
    (hcompare : ∀ i, l ≤ i → i < l + k → w i = inv (w (a - i))) :
    False := by
  have hcenter_lo : l ≤ a / 2 := by omega
  have hcenter_hi : a / 2 < l + k := by omega
  by_cases heven : a % 2 = 0
  · have hmirror : a - a / 2 = a / 2 := by omega
    have hc := hcompare (a / 2) hcenter_lo hcenter_hi
    rw [hmirror] at hc
    exact hfixed (w (a / 2)) hc.symm
  · have hodd : a % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have hu : a / 2 + 1 < l + k := by omega
    have hmirror : a - (a / 2 + 1) = a / 2 := by omega
    have hc := hcompare (a / 2 + 1) (by omega) hu
    rw [hmirror] at hc
    exact hreduced (a / 2) (by omega) hc

theorem occurrence_balance
    {O B : Type*} [Fintype O] [DecidableEq O] [DecidableEq B]
    (owner : O → B) (matched : Finset O) (pair : O → O)
    (_hclosed : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair o ∈ matched)
    (hinvol : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair (pair o) = o)
    (hdifferent : ∀ o ∈ matched, owner (pair o) ≠ owner o)
    (r : B) :
    2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = r)).card ≤
      Fintype.card O + matchedᶜ.card := by
  classical
  let R := Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = r)
  have hmap : Set.MapsTo pair ((R ∩ matched : Finset O) : Set O)
      ((Rᶜ : Finset O) : Set O) := by
    intro o ho
    have hoR : owner o = r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).1).2
    have hd := hdifferent o (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).2
    simpa [R, hoR] using hd
  have hinj : Set.InjOn pair ((R ∩ matched : Finset O) : Set O) := by
    intro o ho o' ho' heq
    have := congrArg pair heq
    simpa [hinvol o (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho).2,
      hinvol o' (Finset.mem_inter.mp ho').2] using this
  have hmatched := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn pair hmap hinj
  have hfree : (R \ matched).card ≤ matchedᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro o ho
    simpa using (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ho).2
  have hpartition := Finset.card_inter_add_card_sdiff R matched
  have htotal := Finset.card_add_card_compl R
  change 2 * R.card ≤ Fintype.card O + matchedᶜ.card
  omega

theorem squared_mass_bin_bound
    {W : Type*} [Fintype W] (p : W → ℝ)
    (D : Finset W) (c Q : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : ∀ w, 0 ≤ p w)
    (hbin : ∀ w ∈ D, c ≤ p w)
    (hmass : ∑ w, (p w) ^ 2 ≤ Q) :
    (D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤ Q := by
  classical
  calc
    (D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 = ∑ _w ∈ D, c ^ 2 := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ w ∈ D, (p w) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro w hw
      have := hbin w hw
      have := hp w
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ ∑ w, (p w) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ D)
      intro w _ _
      positivity
    _ ≤ Q := hmass

theorem projected_moment_bound
    {V A B : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq B]
    (F : Finset (V → A)) (seed root : Finset V)
    (rank : V → ℕ) (parent : V → V) (turn : V → A → A)
    (hroot : root ⊆ seed)
    (hlower : ∀ v, v ∉ seed → rank (parent v) < rank v)
    (hdep : ∀ w ∈ F, ∀ v, v ∉ seed → w v = turn v (w (parent v)))
    (p : ({v : V // v ∈ root} → A) → ℝ) (c Q : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hp : ∀ r, 0 ≤ p r)
    (hmass : ∑ r, (p r) ^ 2 ≤ Q)
    (hbin : ∀ w ∈ F, c ≤ p (fun v => w v.val))
    (project : (V → A) → B) :
    ((F.image project).card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤
      Q * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by
  classical
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun r => c ≤ p r)
  have hdict : ∀ w ∈ F, (fun v : {v : V // v ∈ root} => w v.val) ∈ D := by
    intro w hw
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hbin w hw⟩
  have hn := projection_code_bound F seed root D rank parent turn
    hroot hlower hdep hdict project
  have hnreal :
      ((F.image project).card : ℝ) ≤
        (D.card : ℝ) * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hm := squared_mass_bin_bound p D c Q hc hp
    (fun r hr => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2) hmass
  calc
    ((F.image project).card : ℝ) * c ^ 2 ≤
        ((D.card : ℝ) * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card) * c ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnreal (sq_nonneg c)
    _ = ((D.card : ℝ) * c ^ 2) *
        (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card := by ring
    _ ≤ Q * (Fintype.card A : ℝ) ^ (seed \ root).card :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (by positivity)

theorem component_exponent
    {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m d : B → ℝ)
    (r : B) (z b delta upper : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i)
    (hupp : ∀ i, d i ≤ upper)
    (hmin : ∀ i, d r ≤ d i)
    (hbalance : 2 * z ≤ (∑ i, m i) + b) :
    -(∑ i, m i * d i) + 2 * z * d r - delta * z ≤
      -(delta / 2) * (∑ i, m i) + upper * b := by
  have hcost : (∑ i, m i) * d r ≤ ∑ i, m i * d i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmin i) (hm i)
  have hrnon : 0 ≤ d r := by have := hlow r; linarith
  have hu : 0 ≤ upper := hrnon.trans (hupp r)
  by_cases hz : 2 * z ≤ ∑ i, m i
  · have hgap := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hz)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlow r))
    have hfree := mul_nonneg hu hb
    nlinarith
  · have hz' : 0 ≤ 2 * z - ∑ i, m i := by linarith
    have hgap := mul_nonneg hz' (sub_nonneg.mpr (hupp r))
    have hfree := mul_nonneg hu (show 0 ≤ b - (2 * z - ∑ i, m i) by linarith)
    have hdecay := mul_nonneg hdelta
      (show 0 ≤ z - (∑ i, m i) / 2 by linarith)
    nlinarith

theorem self_component_exponent
    {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m d : B → ℝ) (delta : ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ i, 0 ≤ m i) (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i) :
    -(∑ i, m i * d i) ≤ -(delta / 2) * (∑ i, m i) := by
  have hcost : (∑ i, m i) * (delta / 2) ≤ ∑ i, m i * d i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlow i) (hm i)
  nlinarith

theorem matched_component_exponent
    {O B : Type*} [Fintype O] [DecidableEq O] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (owner : O → B) (matched : Finset O) (pair : O → O)
    (hclosed : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair o ∈ matched)
    (hinvol : ∀ o ∈ matched, pair (pair o) = o)
    (hdifferent : ∀ o ∈ matched, owner (pair o) ≠ owner o)
    (d : B → ℝ) (r rmax : B) (delta upper : ℝ)
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hlow : ∀ i, delta / 2 ≤ d i)
    (hupp : ∀ i, d i ≤ upper)
    (hmin : ∀ i, d r ≤ d i) :
    -(∑ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ) * d i) +
        2 * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) * d r -
        delta * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) ≤
      -(delta / 2) * (Fintype.card O : ℝ) + upper * (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) := by
  have hsum : (∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card) =
      Fintype.card O := by
    simpa using
      (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
        (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.univ)
        (f := owner) (by intro o _; exact Finset.mem_univ _)).symm
  have hsreal :
      (∑ i, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ)) =
        (Fintype.card O : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hbal := occurrence_balance owner matched pair hclosed hinvol hdifferent rmax
  have hbalreal :
      2 * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (Fintype.card O : ℝ) + (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbal
  have hx := component_exponent
    (fun i => ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = i)).card : ℝ))
    d r ((Finset.univ.filter (fun o => owner o = rmax)).card : ℝ)
    (matchedᶜ.card : ℝ) delta upper
    (by intro i; positivity) hdelta (by positivity)
    hlow hupp hmin (by simpa [hsreal] using hbalreal)
  simpa [hsreal] using hx

theorem uniform_epsilon_budget
    (delta a H b error epsilon : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < delta) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (he : epsilon ≤ delta / (16 * (1 + a)))
    (hb : b ≤ epsilon * H)
    (herr : error ≤ delta * H / 8) :
    -(delta / 2) * H + a * b + error ≤ -(delta / 4) * H := by
  have hden : 0 < 16 * (1 + a) := by positivity
  have he' : epsilon * (16 * (1 + a)) ≤ delta :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp he
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he' hH
  have hab := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb ha
  have hsmall : a * (epsilon * H) ≤ delta * H / 16 := by
    by_cases hn : 0 ≤ epsilon
    · have hnon := mul_nonneg hn hH
      nlinarith
    · have hn' : epsilon * H ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_ge hn) hH
      have ha' := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha hn'
      have hpos := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hd) hH
      nlinarith
  nlinarith

theorem log129_lt_five : Real.log 129 < 5 := by
  have he : (21 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 20) := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 / 20 : ℝ)]
  have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 21 / 20) he 100
  have heq : Real.exp (1 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 100 = Real.exp 5 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [heq] at hp
  apply (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 129)).mpr
  have hr : (129 : ℝ) < (21 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 100 := by norm_num
  exact hr.trans_le hp

theorem manuscript_epsilon_budget
    (H b error : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hb : b ≤ H / 57600) (he : error ≤ H / 4800) :
    -(1 / 1200 : ℝ) * H + 5 * b + error ≤ -(1 / 2400 : ℝ) * H := by
  nlinarith

end OccurrenceEntropy

claims.natural_statement: For every finite combinatorial graph immersion into a finite rose and every prescribed vertex set R, absence of the specified reduced spherical arrangements implies pi_2(X)=0 and nonidentity group label for every graph path from r in R to y distinct from r; the universal cover is contractible and pi_1(X) is torsion-free.
Every essential sphere map into the cone complex has an essential finite cone picture; every null-homotopy of a graph-path label has a disk cone picture with the specified actual boundary graph path.

A paired band on the same underlying graph edge in a minimal genuine failure picture can be cancelled in each of the four incidence cases, strictly reducing total boundary length while retaining the fixed distinct graph endpoints or a nonzero spherical summand in one common lifted cone.

Every connected two-dimensional CW complex with pi_2=0 has contractible universal cover and torsion-free fundamental group, by cellular acyclicity and the prime-cyclic periodic-resolution obstruction.

Exactly the declarations of ConePicture in research/topology/Main.lean: universal augmented cone-chain exactness, actual finite graph incidence augmentation zero, and closed-in-cone residual conservation with a nonzero surviving summand and strict boundary-length descent; no surface or full C_TOPOLOGY formalization is asserted.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace ConePicture

variable {A B C T : Type*}
variable [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C] [AddCommGroup T]

def coneD2 (δ : A →+ B) (a : A) : A × B :=
  (a, -δ a)

def coneD1 (δ : A →+ B) (ε : B →+ C) (x : A × B) : B × C :=
  (δ x.1 + x.2, -ε x.2)

def coneD0 (ε : B →+ C) (x : B × C) : C :=
  ε x.1 + x.2

theorem coneD2_injective (δ : A →+ B) : Function.Injective (coneD2 δ) := by
  intro a b h
  exact congrArg Prod.fst h

theorem coneD2_zero_iff (δ : A →+ B) (a : A) :
    coneD2 δ a = 0 ↔ a = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  · rintro rfl
    simp [coneD2]

theorem coneD1_coneD2 (δ : A →+ B) (ε : B →+ C)
    (hεδ : ∀ a, ε (δ a) = 0) (a : A) :
    coneD1 δ ε (coneD2 δ a) = 0 := by
  simp [coneD1, coneD2, hεδ]

theorem coneD0_coneD1 (δ : A →+ B) (ε : B →+ C)
    (hεδ : ∀ a, ε (δ a) = 0) (x : A × B) :
    coneD0 ε (coneD1 δ ε x) = 0 := by
  simp [coneD0, coneD1, map_add, hεδ]

theorem cone_exact_one (δ : A →+ B) (ε : B →+ C)
    (hεδ : ∀ a, ε (δ a) = 0) (x : A × B) :
    coneD1 δ ε x = 0 ↔ ∃ a, coneD2 δ a = x := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : δ x.1 + x.2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst h
    refine ⟨x.1, Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
    change -δ x.1 = x.2
    calc
      -δ x.1 = -δ x.1 + (δ x.1 + x.2) := by rw [hb]; simp
      _ = x.2 := by abel
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact coneD1_coneD2 δ ε hεδ a

theorem cone_exact_zero (δ : A →+ B) (ε : B →+ C)
    (hεδ : ∀ a, ε (δ a) = 0) (z : B × C) :
    coneD0 ε z = 0 ↔ ∃ x, coneD1 δ ε x = z := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(0, z.1), Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩
    · simp [coneD1]
    · change -ε z.1 = z.2
      change ε z.1 + z.2 = 0 at h
      calc
        -ε z.1 = -ε z.1 + (ε z.1 + z.2) := by rw [h]; simp
        _ = z.2 := by abel
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact coneD0_coneD1 δ ε hεδ x

theorem cone_augmentation_surjective (ε : B →+ C) :
    Function.Surjective (coneD0 ε) := by
  intro c
  exact ⟨(0, c), by simp [coneD0]⟩

def graphIncidence {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V]
    (source target : E → V) : (E → ℤ) →+ (V → ℤ) where
  toFun a v := ∑ e, ((if target e = v then a e else 0) -
    (if source e = v then a e else 0))
  map_zero' := by
    funext v
    simp
  map_add' a b := by
    funext v
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    split_ifs <;> ring

def graphAugmentation {V : Type*} [Fintype V] : (V → ℤ) →+ ℤ where
  toFun a := ∑ v, a v
  map_zero' := by simp
  map_add' a b := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem graph_augmentation_incidence {V E : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V]
    (source target : E → V) (a : E → ℤ) :
    graphAugmentation (graphIncidence source target a) = 0 := by
  classical
  change (∑ v, ∑ e, ((if target e = v then a e else 0) -
    (if source e = v then a e else 0))) = 0
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp

theorem graph_cone_exact {V E : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V]
    (source target : E → V) :
    Function.Injective (coneD2 (graphIncidence source target)) ∧
      (∀ a, coneD1 (graphIncidence source target) graphAugmentation
        (coneD2 (graphIncidence source target) a) = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, coneD1 (graphIncidence source target) graphAugmentation x = 0 ↔
        ∃ a, coneD2 (graphIncidence source target) a = x) ∧
      (∀ z, coneD0 graphAugmentation z = 0 ↔
        ∃ x, coneD1 (graphIncidence source target) graphAugmentation x = z) ∧
      Function.Surjective (coneD0 (graphAugmentation (V := V))) := by
  have hεδ := graph_augmentation_incidence source target
  exact ⟨coneD2_injective _, coneD1_coneD2 _ _ hεδ,
    cone_exact_one _ _ hεδ, cone_exact_zero _ _ hεδ,
    cone_augmentation_surjective _⟩

theorem residual_conservation (δ : A →+ B) (push : A →+ T)
    (z z₁ z₂ : T) (q : A)
    (hclosed_in_cone : coneD2 δ q = 0)
    (hcut : z - z₁ - z₂ = push q) :
    z = z₁ + z₂ := by
  have hq : q = 0 := (coneD2_zero_iff δ q).mp hclosed_in_cone
  rw [hq, map_zero] at hcut
  calc
    z = (z - z₁ - z₂) + (z₁ + z₂) := by abel
    _ = z₁ + z₂ := by rw [hcut]; simp

theorem essential_split (δ : A →+ B) (push : A →+ T)
    (z z₁ z₂ : T) (q : A)
    (hclosed_in_cone : coneD2 δ q = 0)
    (hcut : z - z₁ - z₂ = push q)
    (hessential : z ≠ 0) :
    z₁ ≠ 0 ∨ z₂ ≠ 0 := by
  have hsum := residual_conservation δ push z z₁ z₂ q hclosed_in_cone hcut
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  exact hessential (by simpa [h.1, h.2] using hsum)

theorem strict_split_descent (old left right rest : ℕ)
    (h : old = left + right + rest + 2) :
    left + rest < old ∧ right + rest < old := by
  omega

end ConePicture
